title: Teleport Block x Faithful 32x
body:
# A Faithful 32x styled texture pack for Teleport Block.

**_This resource pack retextures the Teleport Block mod to better match the Faithful 32x visual style while preserving the original design and readability._**

## Features:

**Faithful 32x inspired textures
Improved visual consistency with Faithful packs
Mod-compatible texture replacements
Lightweight and easy to install**

## Requirements:

Teleport Block mod
Matching Minecraft version

## Installation:

> Install Teleport Block.
> Place this resource pack into the resourcepacks folder.
> Enable it in Minecraft Resource Packs settings.
